g.text: <tspan x="1240" dy="0">Drag and drop the correct labels from</tspan> <tspan x="1240" dy="25">the word bank to the corresponding</tspan> <tspan x="1240" dy="25">numbered slots on the diagram.</tspan> <tspan x="1240" dy="50">Match all 10 parts of the flower to</tspan> <tspan x="1240" dy="25">complete the activity.</tspan>
• The Stamen (Male) consists of the Anther and Filament.
• The Pistil (Female) consists of the Stigma, Style, and Ovary.
• Petals attract pollinators; Sepals protect the bud.
- Female parts are in the center (Pistil).
- The Pistil is Stigma -> Style -> Ovary.
